title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Lawrence traditions spanning painted landmarks, winter reinventions, milestone processions, music, dance, kindness, and extremely strange trivia.

cards.title: Paint a Two-Ton Class Gift
cards.subtitle: A granite canvas beside Main Hall
cards.notes: Walk past Main Hall to see how the latest coat of paint has transformed the Class of 1895’s much-pranked granite gift.
cards.short_summary: Generations of Lawrentians have turned a two-ton boulder into an ever-changing campus artifact.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence says the Class of 1895 brought The Rock to campus and that generations have painted it and incorporated it into campus pranks.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: The university places The Rock beside Main Hall; observe current campus access rules when visiting.

cards.title: Wait for a Lake That Isn’t There
cards.subtitle: Ormsby Green’s winter alter ego
cards.notes: Look for the seasonal transformation during Winter Term, when Ormsby Green becomes a setting for skating and broomball.
cards.short_summary: A campus lawn temporarily acquires a lake name—and winter recreation—without becoming an actual lake.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence documents that Ormsby Green becomes “Ormsby Lake” each winter for skating, broomball, and other snowy activities during Winter Term.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: This is a seasonal Winter Term tradition; conditions and scheduled activities vary, so consult Lawrence event information first.

cards.title: Inherit Another Class’s Color
cards.subtitle: A Milwaukee-Downer tradition adopted in 1988
cards.notes: Find your class color, then watch for its flag in the incoming class photo—the color cycles forward from a graduating class.
cards.short_summary: Each entering class receives a shared color passed forward through Lawrence’s class-year cycle.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence says it adopted class colors from Milwaukee-Downer College in 1988 to encourage unity and give each graduating class a shared identity.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: Class colors are an institutional tradition rather than a separately ticketed public event.

cards.title: Enter One Way, Graduate the Other
cards.subtitle: Bookend processions through the Lawrence Arch
cards.notes: Watch the arch during arrival and Commencement: new students process toward Main Hall, while graduates make the reverse milestone passage.
cards.short_summary: One Nordic-inspired arch frames ceremonial journeys at both ends of a Lawrence education.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence identifies two milestone traditions at the Lawrence Arch: incoming students process to Main Hall, and graduates pass through the arch after Commencement.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: The processions occur around new-student welcome and Commencement; consult the relevant university schedule for access.

cards.title: Answer the Questions Nobody Studies For
cards.subtitle: Lawrence’s marathon of deliberately bizarre trivia
cards.notes: Form a team and follow the official contest instructions before attempting the rapid stream of obscure questions with players worldwide.
cards.short_summary: An internationally played Lawrence contest makes obscure knowledge the center of an hours-long team ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence says teams around the world compete in the Great Midwest Trivia Contest by answering hours of unusually obscure questions.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: Participation details and timing are contest-specific; verify the current edition through Lawrence before forming a team.

cards.title: Turn Main Hall Green into LUaroo
cards.subtitle: A weekend festival for student and Midwest bands
cards.notes: Check the announced lineup, then head to Main Hall Green to hear Lawrence student groups share a bill with regional performers.
cards.short_summary: Lawrence stages its own weekend music festival on the central green instead of in a conventional venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence describes LUaroo as a weekend-long music festival that brings Midwest and Lawrence student bands to Main Hall Green.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: LUaroo is an annual campus event; confirm the current lineup, schedule, attendance rules, and weather plans before going.

cards.title: Make Kindness Last Exactly 17 Days
cards.subtitle: A Lawrence community-wide practice
cards.notes: Join the announced activities or choose a concrete act of encouragement each day as the campus marks its 17-day kindness observance.
cards.short_summary: Lawrence gives everyday generosity a distinctive seventeen-day campus framework.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence documents 17 Days of Kindness as a celebration of generosity, encouragement, and everyday community connection.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: Specific activities may change between observances; use Lawrence’s calendar or announcements for current participation details.

cards.title: Treat Deep Winter Like Carnival Season
cards.subtitle: Cold-weather community during Winter Term
cards.notes: Bundle up and consult the activity schedule before joining the seasonal games and gatherings that animate the middle of Winter Term.
cards.short_summary: Lawrentians answer Wisconsin’s coldest academic term with an organized burst of seasonal campus activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence describes Winter Carnival as a tradition bringing students together for seasonal activities and community connection during Winter Term.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: Winter Carnival offerings depend on the year and conditions; verify current dates, locations, and participation requirements.

cards.title: Trade Study Clothes for the President’s Ball
cards.subtitle: Spring Term dancing with jazz and a DJ
cards.notes: Check the event announcement, dress for dancing, and plan an evening around the live jazz, DJ set, and food documented by Lawrence.
cards.short_summary: A university-hosted spring dance combines live jazz and a DJ under one unusually presidential name.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence documents the President’s Ball as a Spring Term event featuring live jazz, a DJ, dancing, and food.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: Attendance details are event-specific; verify the current date, venue, eligibility, ticketing, and guest rules with Lawrence.

cards.title: See Campus Cultures Take the Stage
cards.subtitle: International heritage presented in performance
cards.notes: Consult the program before attending, then notice how students use performance to share cultural traditions represented at Lawrence.
cards.short_summary: Lawrence’s international community turns cultural heritage into a recurring campus performance tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence states that Cabaret celebrates the cultural heritage of its international students, whose perspectives represent 34 countries.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions: A History You Can Join
cards.access_notes: Cabaret scheduling and attendance arrangements may change; consult Lawrence’s current event listing before attending.
